meta.title: The Ferry Leaflet
meta.textType: functional: a leaflet with a route diagram and times

paragraphs: On Thursday, January seventh, the Explorers met in the school library. Teacher Kim gave each pair a leaflet for the trip on Saturday. It was called "Blue Ferry." The leaflet had four boxes: "Times," "Fares," "Stops," and "Questions." Mia, Leo, May, and Lily looked at it with Teacher Kim. "This is the timetable for our boat," said Teacher Kim. "Please read it." "Then ask your questions."

The box "Times" said that the boats go every twenty minutes on weekdays. On Saturdays and Sundays, the boats leave Town Pier. They leave at quarter past and quarter to the hour. "How often do the boats go on Saturday?" asked Mia. "They go every thirty minutes," said Leo. Below the boxes, there was a diagram of the route. A blue line had five dots. A small boat sat above the line. The dots were Town Pier, School Pier, Market Pier, Park Pier, and Hill Pier. Town Pier is the port of our town. The diagram showed that the boat goes from Town Pier to Hill Pier.

Teacher Kim went to the board. She wrote the day and the place: "Saturday, January ninth. Town Pier, half past eight." "We will take the boat that leaves at quarter to nine," she said. "It will arrive at Hill Pier at twenty-five past nine." Lily copied the words into her notebook. Leo drew a small boat beside them.

"How much is a ticket?" asked Lily. Leo read the box "Fares." "A single ticket costs thirty baht for an adult and fifteen baht for a child," he said. "A group of ten or more has a discount of five baht each." "We are more than ten children, so we get a discount," said May. "We need two single tickets, one for each trip," said Mia. "Every passenger on the boat needs a ticket," said Teacher Kim.

"How long is the trip?" asked May. Leo found the answer under "Questions." "The trip takes forty minutes," he read. A note said that the boats can have a short delay when the river is high. "If the boat is late, we will wait at the pier," said Teacher Kim. "The boat goes across the river and under a long bridge." The children were ready for Saturday. The leaflet helped them a lot.
text.summary: Teacher Kim gives the Explorers a leaflet about the blue ferry for Saturday's trip. The children read the times, the fares, and the route diagram, and they ask questions that the leaflet answers.
